description: The monorepo at a commit where three shared packages are declared at different ranges in different workspaces, four library packages publish deliberately wide peer ranges for solid-js, and the npm registry is unreachable. Tests whether a dependency audit finds every range disagreement across the workspaces and aligns each to the highest range already declared, leaves the peer ranges alone, and — with no registry — says the staleness half of the audit did not run rather than filling the report with versions and dates it never fetched.
